summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test plus a non-node input test. The 38 tests in the new module and test/test_path.py pass under the prepared venv. Not verified: mypy, black, and isort were not available in the venv, so type-check and formatting are checked by hand only. Nothing committed, and no existing files were modified.
